Overall, the exploratory results are inconsistent with what Gray et al. (2011) concluded

about the first effect. They concluded that body focus leads to redistribution of mind perception.

With ‘body focus’, it denotes focusing on the body by exposing more skin, whether or not the

observer sexualizes the target, although it would strengthen the effect. Thus, following this notion,

we should have found that perceived agency in the clothed target is the highest while that of the

sexual target is the lowest. On the other hand, we should have found that perceived experience in

the clothed target is the lowest while that of the sexual target is the highest. Nevertheless, our

results showed a different picture.

(2019) illustrated that blame is consistently more extreme and differentiated than praise. In other
